mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_building (building_name, floors, units, total_households, occupancy_rate, build_year, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{buildingName}, #{floors}, #{units}, #{totalHouseholds}, #{occupancyRate}, #{buildYear}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.building_name AS buildingName, COUNT(h.id) AS houseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupiedCount FROM t_building b LEFT JOIN t_house h ON h.building_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.building_name ORDER BY b.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_house WHERE status = 1
